material.locator: ICRC, Handbook on International Rules Governing Military Operations (2013), Part I, §§2.1.0.5–2.1.0.6 “What is a treaty?” and “Who is bound by treaties?”, p. 46.
material.description: Provides independent doctrinal context for the treaty character of the UN Charter and the question of who is bound by treaties. The specific UN Charter principles in Claim B are established directly by the Charter, not by this handbook passage.
